visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a well-lit gym studio with a muscular male character in a brown tank top performing heavy shoulder presses on a black and grey machine. His face shows intense concentration and physical strain as he pushes the weight upward. The background features other gym equipment and blurred figures of other gym-goers. (2) Transitioning to a brightly lit indoor kitchen or prep area, the shirtless man pours liquid from a blue bottle into a clear glass bowl, followed by adding a scoop of white powder from a shaker. He then slices a yellow lemon on a wooden surface and squeezes the juice into the bowl, his muscular physique highlighted by the overhead lighting. (3) The setting shifts to a modern bathroom where the man is brushing his teeth with a white toothbrush. He then applies various skincare products, including a spray-on mist and a liquid exfoliant from a black bottle labeled 'EXFOLIATE', rubbing them onto his face and torso with careful, rhythmic hand movements. (4) Back in a dressing area, the man puts on a dark brown tank top, a black baseball cap with white text, and black socks. He handles a black pouch labeled 'VERVE' and consumes a small supplement packet, followed by a drink from a white shaker bottle. (5) Returning to the gym, he is seen loading heavy weight plates onto a machine and then performing various exercises including chest presses and lateral raises. His muscles are visibly pumped and covered in sweat, emphasizing the high-intensity nature of the workout under bright studio lights. (6) The final phases show him running intensely on a treadmill, performing tricep dips, and finally showering under a high-pressure showerhead. The video concludes with him preparing a protein shake, pouring powder from a large purple bag into a shaker, and shaking it vigorously.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop track with a prominent synth bassline and clear male vocals. This is interspersed with the heavy, rhythmic clanking of gym machinery and the sound of weights hitting their stacks, creating a sense of intense physical exertion and drive. (2) A quick transition occurs where the music dips slightly to emphasize the sharp sound of liquid pouring into a glass bowl and the crisp, wet crunch of a lemon being sliced on a board. These foley effects are highly detailed and clear, suggesting a clean, clinical environment. (3) The rhythmic scrubbing sound of a toothbrush and the airy hiss of a spray bottle follow, accompanied by the squelching sound of lotion being rubbed onto skin. These sounds are closely synced with the fast visual cuts of the grooming routine. (4) The audio complexity increases with the rustling of fabric as a shirt is put on, and the sharp plastic crinkle of a supplement packet being opened. A metallic click of a shaker bottle closing and the rhythmic sloshing of water provide a textural bridge back to the workout phase. (5) The final sequence is dominated by the rapid thumping of feet on a treadmill and the heavy splash of water in a shower, all layered under the continuous, driving beat of the BGM. The video ends with a loud, repeated shaking sound of a protein bottle and a satisfying final click.
